outcome_evidence: Frame 0 in image and left_ego_image shows the oven door open and lowered. The robot approaches and aligns with the door, then raises it toward the oven during frames 81–96 in image and left_ego_image, with the door also visible nearby in wrist_image. By frame 97 the door is upright against the oven front; it remains closed as the gripper withdraws through frame 130. No failed attempt or unintended object displacement is visible.
